search.website_text:
BetterHousing | Furniture selection that actually works properly # Install Guide
Add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sevii77/properhousing/master/repo.json` to your Custom Plugin Repositories in `/xlsettings` > Experimental

# Support
If you wish to support me and my work, you can do so [here](https://buymeacoffee.com/sevii77)

variant.author: Sevii
variant.changelog:
Testing Release:
- Added an option to control displaying distances specifically during Duty Recorder playback.  This is enabled by default and ignores other condition settings.
- Added an option to show distances from the selected character instead of your own character during Duty Recorder playback.  This is enabled by default.
